.lbf-gt i{margin-left:auto;width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(45deg);transition:transform .2s}

.lbf-at{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid var(--i);border-radius:999px;background:var(--i);font-size:12.5px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.lbf-at:after{content:"\00d7";font-size:15px;line-height:1;color:#E7C785}

.lbf-cel .lbf-atalho{flex:none}
.lbf-cel .lbf-abre{flex:1 0 100%;justify-content:center;height:42px;border:1px solid var(--l2);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;font:600 13px/1 var(--lb-sans,Jost,Arial,sans-serif);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--i)}

.lbf-abre b{min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:9px;background:#E7C785;color:var(--i);font-size:10.5px;line-height:18px;letter-spacing:0;text-align:center}
